column1: # Turns ASR phonetics of technical English terms (spoken in mostly-Chinese
# dictation) back into the correct spelling before voxtype types the text.
# Format:  找什么 <TAB> 替换成什么        ('#' comments / blank lines ignored)
# Single-ASCII-token sources match case-insensitively at word boundaries
# (so 'git' never corrupts 'digit'); CJK / phrases are plain substring replace.
# Iterate by dictating and checking:  echo "把代码推到吉特哈布上" | texp-vtext
# then add whatever SenseVoice actually emits on this machine. First match wins.
